action.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$json = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $path = $json.tool_input.path; if ($path -match '\.env$|credentials\.json$|id_rsa$|\.pem$') { Write-Error 'Blocked: writing to a secrets-bearing file is not allowed via automated hooks.'; exit 2 } else { exit 0 }"
